                if len(cells)>=2 and all(cell not in done for cell in cells):

                    a,b=cells[-1][0]+d[0],cells[-1][1]+d[1]
                    while 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w:
                        g[a][b]=c; a+=d[0]; b+=d[1]
    return g
